description:
It's been a full thirty years. My childhood friend, Junseok, whom I've spent thirty years with, is going on an arranged date for marriage. He had never even spared a glance for any woman, let alone dated, but that Junseok is Suhyeon's first love and unrequited love. At this thunderbolt-like news, drastic measures were needed.     

“Kang Suhyeon, come down. Are you doing this because you don't know what 'devouring' means?”     

“Ah, I know.”     

“If you know and still do this, I have no reason to be patient.”     

Sex with Junseok, something I'd only ever imagined. If he has no experience in dating or sex, then all I need to do is tame him with my body and make him follow only me.     

“Just four more times with me.”    

“What?”     

“Including yesterday, five times. Let's sleep together just five times.”    

Five times. Within those five times, I have to capture him.… 

Who's getting devoured?
